mounts.name: Felsteed
mounts.description: Corrupted by demonic power and once forced to serve the Shadow Council.

mounts.name: Warhorse
mounts.description: Trained to stand firm in righteous combat.

mounts.name: Dreadsteed
mounts.description: WARNING: It craves only fel energy. Not apples. It hates the seeds.

mounts.name: Charger
mounts.description: Redeemed by the Light. Devoted to your cause.

mounts.name: Thalassian Charger
mounts.description: Basking in the power of M'uru has strengthened its will.

mounts.name: Thalassian Warhorse
mounts.description: A loyal companion to any who would protect Silvermoon.

mounts.name: Acherus Deathcharger
mounts.description: Some horses merely adopt the dark. This horse was born in it, molded by it.

mounts.name: Winged Steed of the Ebon Blade
mounts.description: Dead or alive, you're coming with me.

mounts.name: Argent Charger
mounts.description: Trained to accept only champions of the Light as a rider.

mounts.name: Sunwalker Kodo
mounts.description: This magnificent beast, adorned in sacred charms and painted with holy imagery, radiates with the warmth of the sun.

mounts.name: Great Sunwalker Kodo
mounts.description: At daybreak, the noble Sunwalkers often perform rituals to bless their mounts, imbuing them with holy magic.

mounts.name: Exarch's Elekk
mounts.description: Draenei exarchs have long marched into war atop these imposing mounts, bred for their razor-sharp tusks.

mounts.name: Great Exarch's Elekk
mounts.description: Only the most distinguished paladins are given the honor of riding this elekk. Its plated armor and purple adornments have been blessed by Prophet Velen himself.

mounts.name: Felsaber
mounts.description: A special creation of Lord Illidan gifted to his most trusted demon hunters.

mounts.name: Archmage's Prismatic Disc
mounts.description: Three elements have been fused to create this magical disc, which is attuned to your specific magical powers.

mounts.name: High Priest's Lightsworn Seeker
mounts.description: Once plentiful, only three seekers remain on Azeroth after generations of battling the corruption of the cosmos.

mounts.name: Ban-Lu, Grandmaster's Companion
mounts.description: The child of Xuen, Ban-Lu has served each Grandmaster faithfully for many years.

mounts.name: Huntmaster's Loyal Wolfhawk
mounts.description: The spirit of the Great Hunter found you worthy, and now its children will answer your call forevermore.

mounts.name: Deathlord's Vilebrood Vanquisher
mounts.description: A powerful red dragon raised in undeath by its own life energies, a true mockery of life.

mounts.name: Battlelord's Bloodthirsty War Wyrm
mounts.description: Also responds to "Mister Bitey."

mounts.name: Slayer's Felbroken Shrieker
mounts.description: You broke it, you bought it.

mounts.name: Huntmaster's Fierce Wolfhawk
mounts.description: A jumble of talons and claws that can fly and swim. No one is safe.

mounts.name: Huntmaster's Dire Wolfhawk
mounts.description: If asked to fetch, will most likely bring you back the head of a small mammal or humanoid.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Murderous Omen
mounts.description: The preferred vehicle for assassinations, they make no sounds when flying - really great for sneaking up on people.

mounts.name: Highlord's Golden Charger
mounts.description: The fanciest of all of the horses.

mounts.name: Farseer's Raging Tempest
mounts.description: Windfury. Overload: (2).

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Lethal Omen
mounts.description: They'll never hear you coming.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Baneful Omen
mounts.description: For the toxin-inclined.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Crimson Omen
mounts.description: The blood of your enemies won't even show up, blends right in.

mounts.name: Highlord's Vengeful Charger
mounts.description: What's he so mad about?

mounts.name: Highlord's Vigilant Charger
mounts.description: His blank horse stare is "vigilance," actually.

mounts.name: Highlord's Valorous Charger
mounts.description: Has many valorous points.

mounts.name: Netherlord's Chaotic Wrathsteed
mounts.description: A deadly combination of fel and horse.

mounts.name: Netherlord's Brimstone Wrathsteed
mounts.description: The smell isn't particularly pleasant, and it REALLY stays with you.

mounts.name: Netherlord's Accursed Wrathsteed
mounts.description: Shadow plus fire, what could go wrong?

mounts.name: Darkforge Ram
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the defenders of Ironforge.

mounts.name: Dawnforge Ram
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the defenders of Ironforge.

mounts.name: Crusader's Direhorn
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the holy crusaders of Zandalar.

mounts.name: Lightforged Ruinstrider
mounts.description: A loyal steed to the Lightforged Draenei.

mounts.name: Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith
mounts.description: Beneath the stone surface beats a heart emboldened by order to set this world free from darkness.

mounts.name: Felscorned Vilebrood Vanquisher
mounts.description: This flying amalgamation of the forces of death and fel pierces the skies with a bone-chilling screech.

mounts.name: Slayer's Felscorned Shrieker
mounts.description: Torn from the heavens by only the most cunning of Demon Hunters.

mounts.name: Felscorned Wolfhawk
mounts.description: Scarred by the war across the Broken Isles, this Wolfhawk deserves a good home.

mounts.name: Archmage's Felscorned Disc
mounts.description: Some mages say fel magics are "volatile" or "corruptive" or "forbidden". Some mages are wrong.

mounts.name: Felscorned Grandmaster's Companion
mounts.description: A twisted visage of a beloved companion.

mounts.name: Felscorned Highlord's Charger
mounts.description: This horse has been irreversibly scarred by the Legion's corrupt magics.

mounts.name: High Priest's Felscorned Seeker
mounts.description: This fel-infused feathered friend flaps its wings at a frenetic pace to remain far above the frenzy below.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Felscorned Omen
mounts.description: Your enemies will know fear before their end.

mounts.name: Farseer's Felscorned Tempest
mounts.description: Fel flavored fury.

mounts.name: Felscorned Netherlord's Dreadsteed
mounts.description: Simply oozing with potential.

mounts.name: Felscorned War Wyrm
mounts.description: The heavens tremble in anticipation of your arrival.
